desc:
Break into a closed Soviet factory, descend into the shelter, and take out all valuable items.

• Finds glow according to their rarity—from a can of stew to an order and a key to the sealed door.
• Locked boxes - break them open with a crowbar, only rare items are inside.
• Every minute, there is a gas leak in the shelter—put on your gas mask (G) and change the filters.
• Bring items back to base and sell them to the buyer. Use the money to purchase gas masks, flashlights, and larger backpacks.
• If you are caught by security, you will lose everything you were carrying on this flight. The warehouse will remain.

This is a beta version: write in the comments what is broken and what is missing.
